title: Spartan backend for Noir (Tom-256)
description: Spartan prover backend for Noir over the Tom-256 curve, whose order equals the base field of P-256, so circuits verify ECDSA-P256 signatures natively. Includes the e-ID circuits (age proof on an unmodified SWIYU SD-JWT with ECDSA-P256 holder binding, SICPA Digital Trust Platform circuits), precomputation of the prover state, and benchmarks. Contains the fixes for the zkSecurity review.
notes: Funded by Innosuisse, grant 101.292 IP-ICT "Secure and Privacy-Preserving Credentials for E-ID", a collaboration between EPFL / C4DT and SICPA SA. Research / demo code, not for production use.
